errors.text: The proposed oxygen addition is not the oxidation-protection intervention; controlled interstitial oxygen can strengthen the alloy but does not establish a protective external scale comparable to the target silicide coating.
The cited evidence concerns Snoek damping and room-temperature mechanical properties of an O-doped related alloy, not oxidation resistance in air at 1000 °C.
The hypothesis omits the coating-mediated self-healing (Zr,Hf)O2 mechanism and provides no evidence that an oxygen-alloyed cast specimen would avoid rapid oxidation.
Exposure time, oxygen-content tolerance, strain rate, and quantitative pass/fail thresholds are insufficiently specified for a controlled test.
